items.stem: What primarily distinguishes the WELL Building Standard from LEED?

options.text: WELL focuses on occupant health and well-being; LEED focuses on building environmental performance
options.rationale: Correct: WELL centres on human health and well-being, while LEED centres on environmental/sustainability performance.

options.text: They measure exactly the same things
options.rationale: Their focus areas differ; they are complementary, not identical.
WELL applies across many building and space types.
LEED covers many environmental categories, not only lighting.

items.explanation: Correct: WELL centres on human health and well-being, while LEED centres on environmental/sustainability performance.

items.stem: In WELL, what is the relationship between preconditions and optimisations?

options.text: Preconditions are required for certification; optimisations are optional and add points toward higher levels
options.rationale: Correct: preconditions are mandatory, and optimisations are optional features that contribute to higher certification levels.

options.text: Optimisations are mandatory and preconditions are optional

options.rationale: Both are central to achieving and raising certification.

items.explanation: Correct: preconditions are mandatory, and optimisations are optional features that contribute to higher certification levels.

items.stem: Select TWO statements that are TRUE about achieving WELL certification.

options.text: Performance verification (on-site testing/review) is part of the process
options.rationale: Correct: WELL uses performance verification to confirm features perform as intended.

options.text: All applicable preconditions must be met before certification is awarded
options.rationale: Correct: preconditions are mandatory for certification.

options.text: Design intent alone is sufficient, with no verification
options.rationale: WELL requires verification, not design intent alone.

options.text: Optimisations are mandatory for a basic certification
options.rationale: Optimisations are optional and add points; preconditions are the mandatory part.

options.text: Documentation is unnecessary for WELL features
options.rationale: Features must be documented to be credited.

items.explanation: Correct: WELL uses performance verification to confirm features perform as intended.
